policy: Literal-level ledger for runtime UI code in src, docs/site/src, website/src, templates/*/src and packages/dev-shell/src. Every detected animation/transition duration literal must appear here and every entry must still exist. Migration replaces a duration with a --uni-duration-* / --uni-motion-* tier (or --uni-loop-* period), then removes its file pairing. Prose and displayed snippets, delay/dwell/auto-dismiss timing and --animate-* definition-internal literals have separate contracts. The remaining historical baseline is frozen by literal, file and occurrence count.
